mission: Watch the platform's own health — internal Vrooli code, lifecycle, autoheal/system-monitor history — and surface durable findings the operator can act on. Detect patterns across runtime incidents, audit internal code along the same dimensions scenario-qa applies to scenarios, and drive internal instrumentation forward so future findings are sharper.

instrument.gapMarker: 2026-08-13 — ten *-health scenarios report per-capability condition and nothing aggregates them; the setpoint exists as prose deadbands in docs/infra-health/strategy/RELIABILITY_TARGETS.md. Closest to ready of the unequipped teams: the denominator is already authored, only the observer is missing.

runtime-health-scanner.lane: Find aggregate runtime-health patterns across durable autoheal incidents, autoheal history, system-monitor, and lifecycle history; produce one concrete finding at a time.
safetyCriticalRules: Pick one signal per heartbeat; depth over breadth.
Never edit platform, autoheal, or system-monitor code.

taskParameters.triageLadder: SSOT is the Task Loop in members/runtime-health-scanner/HEARTBEAT.md — walk the ladder there in order (rounds 2-3 expanded it beyond the original five tiers). Do not maintain a second copy here.

platform-code-auditor.lane: Audit one slice of internal Vrooli platform code per heartbeat and route concrete findings through work items.
safetyCriticalRules: Never edit internal platform code directly.
Do not audit scenario code; scenario-qa owns that lane.

infra-contrarian.lane: Challenge infra-health work items against the team failure-mode rubric and run the stale work item scan. Also this team's shape sensor: hold the team against the target model's deviation catalogue and report deviations; never restructure.
safetyCriticalRules: Do not generate runtime or platform findings.
Do not edit code or plan-of-record docs.
Do not synthesize other members into a leader-style brief.

taskParameters.frameworkMetaCadence: at most one per calendar month
taskParameters.failureModes: SSOT is the Failure-Mode Rubric + Mechanical Thresholds in members/infra-contrarian/RESPONSIBILITIES.md — the operative set includes the mechanical fails (unit mismatch, dead-sensor, roster creep, cascade violation) added in rounds 2-3. Do not maintain a second copy here.
